entries.title: Start from what you came for, and add the rest when you need it
entries.summary: Your sidebar now opens on the job you signed up for, such as webinars, field events or clips. **Add more** opens **Add to Marketing**, with 13 things you can add: every one is on your plan, adding is free and removing deletes nothing. Ask can add them too: "Add Podcast to Marketing".
entries.use_case: A team that came for webinars sees webinars first, not ten menus, and adds a podcast or a newsletter in one click when it's ready, at no extra cost.
